title: TrainingExample / EvaluationExample
description: One supervised example for the HEQK intelligence tiers (docs/research/neuro/09: B fast specialists, C temporal, D language). The same record serves training and evaluation; `split` says which. The input is evidence (events or evidence cards), never raw packets. The target holds what the label source asserted; `reasoning` is null unless a human or an explicitly synthetic generator wrote it. Confidence is null unless the label source gives one: this tooling never invents calibration.

id.description: <collection prefix>-<first 16 hex of content_sha256>; stable across rebuilds of the same content.

task.description: classify = verdict on one event (tier B training/eval); triage = verdict + next step on an evidence window (tier D eval, L0 comparison); explain = write the why given a SUPPLIED verdict (tier D's actual job); map_attack = technique mapping; knowledge = taxonomy fact recall for retrieval/eval.

records.description: Normalised records (heqk.security-event/1) the example is built from, in time order. Bounded: an example is a window, not a dataset.

context.description: Untrusted-by-construction environment facts (device role, network segment). Free text from telemetry must be quoted here, never placed in the question.

evidence.description: record_ids from input.records that support the label.

answer.description: Free-text answer for knowledge / explain tasks; null for pure classification.

type.description: dataset_label: the upstream dataset's label. feed_assertion: a threat feed listed it (true at listing time, not forever). knowledge_base: a taxonomy fact. analyst: a HookProbe human reviewed it. synthetic: generated; never presented as real telemetry.

verified.description: true only when a human reviewed this example or the upstream label is documented as manually verified.

group_key.description: Everything sharing a group_key lands in the same split (registrable domain, scenario, CVE, source host). Prevents near-duplicate leakage.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of {collection, task, input minus provenance, target}. Exact-duplicate and contamination key.
